mn103:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
mn103:2.2: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, iti bhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’ti.
mn103:2.3: na kho no bhante, bhagavati evaṃ hoti:
mn103:2.4: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, itibhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’ti.
mn103:2.5: na ca kira vo bhikkhave, mayi evaṃ hoti:
mn103:2.6: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu
mn103:2.7: vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, iti bhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’ti.
mn103:2.8: atha kinti carahi vo bhikkhave, mayi hotī’ti.
mn103:2.9: evaṃ kho no bhante, bhagavati hoti:
mn103:2.12: evañca kira vo bhikkhave mayi hoti:
mn103:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, ye vo mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, seyyathidaṃ:
mn103:3.2: ‘cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo. tattha sabbeheva samaggehi sammodamānehi avivadamānehi sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn103:4.1: tesañca vo bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, tattha siyuṃ dve bhikkhū abhidhamme nānāvādā.
mn103:5.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nāna’nti. tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:5.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
mn103:5.5: yathā atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
mn103:5.7: athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:5.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
mn103:5.10: yathā atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ
mn103:5.12: iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
mn103:5.13: duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:6.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sametī’ti. tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:6.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
mn103:6.5: yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
mn103:6.7: athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:6.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
mn103:6.10: ‘yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
mn103:6.12: iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
mn103:6.13: duggahitaṃ dughitato dhāretvā suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:7.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho sameti, byañjanato nāna’nti. tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:7.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi sameti. byañjanato nānaṃ.
mn103:7.5: ‘yathā atthato hi kho sameti. byañjanato nānaṃ.
mn103:7.8: athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:7.9: āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ.
mn103:7.11: ‘yathā atthato hi kho sameti. byañjanato nānaṃ.
mn103:7.14: iti suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
mn103:7.15: suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:8.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato ceva sameti. byañjanato ca sametī’ti. tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo :
mn103:8.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva sameti, byañjanato ca sameti.
mn103:8.5: ‘yathā atthato ceva sameti, byañjanato ca sameti.
mn103:8.7: athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo :
mn103:8.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva sameti, byañjanato ca sameti.
mn103:8.10: ‘yathā atthato ceva sameti, byañjanato ca sameti.
mn103:8.13: suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:9.1: tesañca vo bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, siyā aññatarassa bhikkhuno āpatti siyā vītikkamo
mn103:10.1: tatra bhikkhave, na codanāya taritabbaṃ, puggalo upaparikkhitabbo,
mn103:10.2: iti mayhañca avihesā bhavissati. parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto, paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cā’haṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetu’nti.
mn103:11.2: ‘mayhaṃ kho avihesā bhavissati. parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto, paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:11.3: appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ yadidaṃ parassa puggalassa upaghāto.
mn103:11.5: ‘sohaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetu’nti.
mn103:12.2: ‘mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati, parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto, paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī. sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:12.5: sohaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetu’nti.
mn103:13.2: mayhañca kho vihesā bhavissati. parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto. paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī. sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:13.3: appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ ‘yadidaṃ mayhañca vihesā parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto.
mn103:13.5: ‘sohaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetu’nti.
mn103:14.2: ‘mayhañca kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto. paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī dandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī. na cāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetu’nti.
mn103:15.1: tesañca vo bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃsāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.
mn103:15.2: tattha ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:15.3: ‘yaṃ no āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃsāro uppanno diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi. taṃ jānamāno samāno garaheyyāti.
mn103:15.4: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn103:15.5: ‘yaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃsāro uppanno diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi. taṃ jānamāno samāno garaheyyāti.
mn103:15.6: etaṃ panāvuso dhammaṃ appahāya nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:15.7: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn103:15.8: etaṃ kho āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’ti.
mn103:16.1: athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacatarā maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn103:16.2: yaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃsāro uppanno diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi. taṃ jānamāno samāno garaheyyāti.
mn103:16.3: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn103:16.4: yaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃsāro uppanno diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi. taṃ jānamāno samāno garaheyyāti.
mn103:16.5: etaṃ panāvuso dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:16.6: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn103:16.7: etaṃ kho āvuso dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’ti.
mn103:17.1: tañce bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
mn103:17.2: āyasmatā no ete bhikkhū akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpitāti.
mn103:17.3: sammā byākaramāno bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya:
mn103:17.4: idhāhaṃ āvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ, tassa me bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi, tāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāsiṃ:
mn103:17.5: taṃ te bhikkhū dhammaṃ sutvā akusalā vuṭṭhahiṃsu. kusale patiṭṭhahiṃsū’ti.
mn103:17.6: evaṃ byākaramāno kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu na ceva attānaṃ ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaroti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī’ti.
mn103:17.8: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
